user.title: Crow Email
user.description: Adds the Crow Email card to your dashboards. Each person then adds their own email accounts in the card.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Crow Email is already set up.

send_email.name: Send email
send_email.description: Sends an email from one of the Crow Email accounts.

account.name: From account
account.description: The account to send from: its email address or its name in Crow Email.

to.name: To
to.description: Who to send to. Separate several addresses with commas.

bcc.name: Bcc
bcc.description: Copied to, without the others seeing.

message.name: Message
message.description: The email, as plain text. The account's signature is added.

html.name: HTML
html.description: The email as HTML instead of plain text (no signature is added).

attachments.name: Attachments
attachments.description: Files to attach, from /config/www (/local/...), /media (/media/local/...) or another allowed folder.

send_at.name: Send at
send_at.description: Send it later, at this time, instead of straight away.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Buttons in the email, each with a title and an action (and optionally a colour). Tapping one fires a crow_email_action event with that action, once. Each button works for two weeks.

poll.name: Voting buttons
poll.description: Two to eight choices. People vote by tapping one and sending the reply that opens; each vote fires a crow_email_vote event.

read_receipt.name: Ask for a read receipt
read_receipt.description: Asks the person's mail app to send a receipt when they open the email (they can choose not to).

mark_as_read.name: Mark as read
mark_as_read.description: Marks an email as read (or unread).

account.name: Account
account.description: The account's email address (or its name in Crow Email).

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: The folder the email is in. INBOX unless you say otherwise.

uid.name: Email
uid.description: The email's uid, from the crow_email_received event (trigger.event.data.uid).

message_id.name: Message-ID
message_id.description: Or find the email by its Message-ID header.

all.name: Every email
all.description: Mark every email in the folder.

archive.name: Archive
archive.description: Moves an email to the account's Archive folder.

message_id.name: Message-ID
message_id.description: Or find the email by its Message-ID header.

move_to_folder.name: Move to folder
move_to_folder.description: Moves an email to another folder.

to_folder.name: To folder
to_folder.description: The folder to move it to, by name.

flag.name: Flag
flag.description: Flags an email (or removes the flag).

refresh.name: Check for new mail
refresh.description: Checks for new mail now and updates the sensors.

account.name: Account
account.description: Just this account. Leave empty for all of them.

update_badge.name: Update app badge
update_badge.description: Brings the red number on the Home Assistant app's icon up to date for the person who owns an account, optionally adding a number of your own (for example parcels on their way). Needs App Icon Badge turned on in the card editor.

account.name: Account
account.description: Any of the person's email accounts, by email address or description.

extra.name: Extra
extra.description: A number added to the badge, kept until you change it. Use 0 to stop adding one.
